Storms can’t dampen the spirit of Akron Pride. Here’s what we saw.

Akron Pride Festival and Equity March celebrated its 10th anniversary this year.

By Joe Adams (he/him)
●
Pride
●
August 22, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

Before, after and even in the middle of some severe storms, the Akron Pride Festival and Equity March celebrated ten years of their mission of unifying and affirming the LGBTQ+ community and its allies.

Thousands gathered from all over the state to march, applaud, stand in their authenticity and be in community with their LGBTQ+ siblings.
